message.content:
**MSFT** is the stock ticker (symbol) used on financial platforms—including Yahoo Finance—to represent **Microsoft Corp.**

On Yahoo Finance you’ll see:

| Item | Description |
|------|-------------|
| Symbol | `MSFT` |
| Exchange | NASDAQ Global Select Market |
| Company name | Microsoft Corporation |
| Sector/Industry | Technology – Software—Infrastructure |

When you search “MSFT” on Yahoo Finance, you'll access all real‑time data for Microsoft’s shares, including price charts, news headlines, analyst ratings, earnings reports, dividend history, and other fundamental metrics.
